Question: How do I place a food delivery order?
Answer: Open the app or website, select your restaurant and desired items, add them to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Choose your delivery address, payment method, and confirm your order.

Question: What payment methods are accepted for food delivery orders?
Answer: Most platforms accept major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), digital wallets like Apple Pay or Google Pay, and sometimes cash on delivery depending on the region. Check the specific app for all options.

Question: How can I track my food delivery order in real time?
Answer: Once your order is confirmed, go to the 'Orders' or 'Track Order' section in the app. You'll typically see progress stages: order received, preparing, picked up, and on the way to you.

Question: Why hasn't my driver arrived yet? My estimated delivery time has passed.
Answer: Delivery times can vary due to traffic, weather, or restaurant prep delays. Check the live map in the app for your driver's location. If it's significantly past the estimate, contact support for an update.

Question: The food arrived cold. What should I do?
Answer: First, check if there's a 'Report an Issue' button on the order details page — many apps let you request a partial or full refund directly. If not, take a photo of the food and contact support within 24 hours.

Question: My order is missing items. How do I get a refund for the missing products?
Answer: Go to the order in your app, select 'Report an Issue' or 'Missing Items,' and specify what's gone. Submit any photos you have, and most platforms will credit your account within 1–3 business days.

Question: Can I modify my order after I've already placed it?
Answer: You can sometimes modify orders before they reach the restaurant by calling them directly. Once the restaurant starts preparing your food, changes are usually no longer possible. Contact support as quickly as you can for any exceptions.

Question: The delivery driver couldn't find my location. What should I do?
Answer: If you're waiting, send precise instructions or a photo of nearby landmarks through the app's chat feature. If they've left and you didn't receive your food, report the order as 'Not Delivered' for a full refund.

Question: Is there a fee for food delivery? How much is it?
Answer: Delivery fees vary by restaurant, distance, and platform. There may also be a service fee and small order fees. These are all itemized at checkout before you confirm your payment.

Question: Can I cancel my food delivery order? When is the latest I can do it?
Answer: You can usually cancel within 2–5 minutes of placing the order for a full refund. After that, once the restaurant starts preparing, you may only get a partial refund or none at all. Check your order page for cancellation options.

Question: Why was my payment charged twice for the same order?
Answer: This is often a temporary double authorization from your bank and usually resolves within 24–48 hours. If both charges persist, take screenshots and contact both your payment provider and the delivery platform's support.

Question: How do I apply a promo code or coupon to my order?
Answer: At checkout, look for a 'Promo Code,' 'Coupon,' or 'Discount' field. Enter your code and tap 'Apply.' The discount will show in your order total before you confirm payment.

Question: My food arrived damaged or spilled. How do I get compensated?
Answer: Take clear photos of the packaging and the mess immediately. Use the app's reporting tool to submit a complaint with those images. You should receive a refund or credit for the affected items within a few days.

Question: Can I reschedule my delivery for a later time?
Answer: Rescheduling isn't typically available after an order is placed. If you need food at a different time, consider canceling the current order (if still eligible) and placing a new one with your preferred delivery window.

Question: Are contactless deliveries an option?
Answer: Yes, most platforms offer contactless delivery. Select it at checkout or during the driver matching phase. The driver will leave the food at your door and notify you via the app.

Question: Why is my delivery taking so long? What's a normal wait time?
Answer: Wait times depend on restaurant prep, distance, and current order volume. A typical wait is 25–45 minutes for most meals. If it exceeds your app's estimated window by more than 15 minutes, that warrants a support inquiry.

Question: Can I split my payment between two different cards?
Answer: Generally, no — most platforms only allow one payment method per order. However, some newer apps are starting to support partial payments with gift cards combined with a credit card. Check your platform's help center for specifics.

Question: My order was delivered to the wrong address. What should I do?
Answer: Contact customer support immediately. If the food is still intact and nearby, they may direct the driver or send a replacement. You'll typically receive a full refund if the food cannot be recovered.

Question: How do I add a tip for my delivery driver?
Answer: You can add a tip during checkout before confirming, or after delivery by going to your order history, selecting the relevant order, and tapping 'Add Tip.' Most platforms let you adjust or increase the tip later as well.

Question: What should I do if the food I received is not what I ordered?
Answer: Take photos of the items you did receive. Use the app's reporting tool to flag 'Wrong Order' with those photos. You'll usually be refunded for the incorrect items or offered a credit toward your next order.

Question: Do I need to be home when my food is delivered?
Answer: For standard delivery, yes — you'll need to accept the handoff. For contactless delivery, no; the driver leaves it at the specified spot and alerts you through the app. Make sure your delivery instructions are clear either way.

Question: How do I request a refund for my order?
Answer: Go to your order history, select the relevant order, tap 'Help' or 'Report an Issue,' choose the problem category, and follow the prompts. Most refunds process back to your original payment method within 3–5 business days.

Question: What happens if it rains during my delivery?
Answer: The driver will still deliver as scheduled, but timing may be delayed. Most platforms factor weather into their estimates and won't penalize you for reasonable weather-related delays. Be patient with your driver's safety.

Question: Can I order food for someone else? Will they know who ordered it?
Answer: Yes, just enter the recipient's address at checkout. You can include a gift message in the delivery notes to let them know who sent it. The receipt typically only shows the buyer's information, not the recipient's.

Question: My refund didn't show up yet. It's been 48 hours.
Answer: Refund timelines depend on your bank. While platforms process refunds instantly on their end, banks can take 3–7 business days to reflect them. Check with your financial institution if it's been longer than a week.

Question: How do I contact customer support for my delivery issue?
Answer: Open the app, go to the order in question, tap 'Help' or 'Support,' and choose from chat, email, or call options. For non-order-specific help, look for the Help Center or FAQ section in the main menu.

Question: Is there a minimum order amount for delivery?
Answer: Some restaurants set a minimum order (e.g., $15) to qualify for delivery, while others don't. This is usually displayed on the restaurant's page before you start ordering. Small-order fees may also apply below a certain threshold.

Question: Can I leave special instructions for my delivery driver?
Answer: Yes, during checkout there's usually a 'Delivery Instructions' or 'Special Notes' field. You can include directions like 'leave at front door,' building codes, gate numbers, or parking details to help the driver find you.

Question: My order arrived late and some items are inedible. What are my options?
Answer: Report the issue immediately through the app with photos. You may be eligible for a full refund on the affected items or a credit toward a future order. If unsatisfied with the resolution, escalate to a human support agent.

Question: Do I need to create an account to place an order?
Answer: You'll need at least a guest checkout account or quick sign-up with your email/phone for any platform. Most apps do require full registration to save addresses, track orders, and manage payments efficiently.

Question: How does the delivery fee get calculated?
Answer: It's based on distance from the restaurant to you, current demand (surge pricing during peak hours), and sometimes a base service fee. The exact breakdown is shown at checkout before you confirm payment.

Question: Can I request a specific delivery time instead of ASAP?
Answer: Yes — select 'Schedule' or 'Choose a Time' at checkout rather than 'ASAP.' You'll pick a window, though deliveries may start slightly early. Note that scheduling isn't available at all restaurants on every platform.

Question: I received the wrong quantity of items. What's my recourse?
Answer: Report it via the app under 'Wrong Order' or 'Incorrect Quantity' with photos. You'll typically get a refund for the missing quantity or store credit. Some platforms issue refunds instantly; others take a few days.

Question: What if I forget to add an item during checkout? Can I still get it?
Answer: If the order hasn't left the restaurant, call them directly and ask if they can slip in the extra item. If it's already en route, your best bet is adding a new order or visiting the restaurant afterward.

Question: How safe are online payments on food delivery platforms?
Answer: Reputable platforms use encrypted payment gateways (PCI compliance) and never store your full card details on their servers. They also support tokenization and fraud monitoring. Always keep your app updated for the latest security patches.

Question: Can I change my delivery address after placing the order?
Answer: You generally cannot change it through the app once placed. Call the restaurant or driver directly with a quick note. For future orders, always double-check your saved address before confirming.

Question: Why does my delivery cost more than the menu price? What are all these fees?
Answer: Menu prices reflect food only. Add-ons include: delivery fee, service/processing fee, small-order surcharge (if applicable), taxes, and optional tip. The final breakdown is always visible before you pay.

Question: How do I earn loyalty points or rewards on my orders?
Answer: Sign up for the platform's loyalty program if available. Points are typically earned per dollar spent and can be redeemed for credits, free delivery, or discounts. Check for partner offers that give bonus multipliers.

Question: The driver canceled on me last minute. How do I get re-compensated?
Answer: You should receive a full refund automatically if the order was canceled by the restaurant or driver. If not, contact support with your order number. You can also place a new order as a backup in case it takes time to resolve.

Question: Can I reorder my last order with one tap?
Answer: Most apps have a 'Reorder' button in the order history that replicates your previous selection. You can still edit quantities or remove items before confirming and paying for the new order.

Question: What if I have a food allergy and need to know ingredients?
Answer: Review the menu item's detailed description on the app for ingredient lists. If not listed, call the restaurant directly to ask. Always inform them of your allergy when placing the order so they can take precautions.

Question: Why was my account suspended from ordering food?
Answer: Accounts are typically suspended due to policy violations: fraudulent activity, repeated no-shows, abuse of refund policies, or payment failures. Review any messages from support for the specific reason and appeal if you believe it's an error.

Question: How do I know if a restaurant is currently open before ordering?
Answer: The app shows operating hours and current availability. Restaurants that are temporarily closed will be grayed out with a 'Currently Closed' label. If they're preparing to close soon, you may still order but delivery time could shift.

Question: My food arrived with the wrong condiments or sides. Can I return them?
Answer: You generally can't 'return' items after delivery, but you can report it through the app for a partial refund or credit on future orders. Most platforms handle this under their satisfaction guarantee policy.

Question: Is there a way to filter restaurants by dietary preference (vegan, gluten-free)?
Answer: Yes — use the app's filters to sort by cuisine type, and check each restaurant's menu for dietary labels. Some apps have dedicated categories like 'Vegetarian Friendly' or 'Healthy Options' in their search page.

Question: How do I report a rude or unprofessional delivery driver?
Answer: Go to your order details and select 'Report an Issue' or 'Driver Behavior.' You can also reach out through the Help Center. Provide specifics and dates so the platform can investigate and take action if warranted.

Question: What should I do if my food is undercooked?
Answer: Contact customer support through the app immediately with photos of the food. You may be offered a refund or credit. For food safety concerns, you can also request that they notify the restaurant for review.

Question: Can I subscribe to a delivery pass for free deliveries?
Answer: Many platforms offer monthly subscriptions (e.g., $9.99/month) that waive delivery fees on eligible orders. These usually have a minimum order threshold but can save you significant money if you order frequently.

Question: How long does it take to get my refund after reporting an issue?
Answer: Most platforms approve refunds within 24 hours of review, and the funds typically reach your account in 3–7 business days depending on your bank. Faster options like wallet credits are usually instant.

Question: Can I request a receipt for my food delivery order?
Answer: Yes — every confirmation email includes a digital receipt. You can also view and download it anytime by going to your Order History, selecting the order, and tapping 'View Receipt' or 'Print.'
